waybackify manifest [flags] <source.md>

Generate the manifest for one markdown source

Generate the manifest (wayback.json) for one markdown source: extract
its live links, bake the Universe subset (compile-time policy), copy
verdicts from the seen union file, and resolve only never-seen urls
against the archive. Idempotent: a rerun with the same seen file
makes zero network calls and writes byte-identical output.

Output: canonical manifest at -o; the seen file (read-write)
extended with this run's verdicts; one JSON stats line on stdout.
Unresolved urls defer — exit 1, rerun to resume.

Arguments:
  <source.md>            markdown source file (pristine, live-link form)

Flags:
  --universe|-u <file>   Universe file (rewrites + excludes policy) — required
  --seen|-s <file>       Manifest-shaped resolution union, read-write (bootstrap: ledger --flatten)
  --output|-o <file>     manifest destination (wayback.json) — required
  --offline              fail on urls the universe and seen file cannot answer (zero network)
  --near <ts>            preferred capture timestamp (YYYYMMDD[HHMMSS]) — resolve never-seen urls to the archive capture closest to it
  --help|-h              Show help

part of the wayback mirror tooling
